entities.name: Economic Reforms and Mass Emigration
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Cuba faces its worst economic crisis since the Special Period, exacerbated by the COVID-19 pandemic, tightened US sanctions, and structural inefficiencies. Hundreds of thousands of Cubans have emigrated, the largest exodus since 1959, driven by shortages of food, medicine, and basic necessities.
